# UniGenius AI

> UniGenius AI is a free AI-powered study platform for Computer Science (CS), Software Engineering (SE) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) university students. It brings together structured topic pages, an AI tutor, video lectures, notes, past papers, a question bank, viva preparation, a code lab, courses and a study planner in one place — matched to the student's degree program and semester.

Founded by Uzair Ahmad Tunio. Free for students; optional Pro plan (Rs 300/month or one-time Lifetime) unlocks higher AI limits and premium features.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://unigenius.vercel.app/): Overview, features and FAQ
- [Study Topics & Notes](https://unigenius.vercel.app/topics): All 615 topic pages across 54 subjects, free previews
- [Video Lectures](https://unigenius.vercel.app/lectures): 100+ curated lecture playlists by subject (Urdu/Hindi and English)
- [Courses](https://unigenius.vercel.app/courses): Free, premium and AI-recommended courses
- [Question Bank](https://unigenius.vercel.app/question-bank): 2,500+ MCQs and practice questions with explanations
- [Notes](https://unigenius.vercel.app/notes): Student-shared and curated study notes
- [Past Papers](https://unigenius.vercel.app/past-papers): Previous exam papers by subject
- [Library](https://unigenius.vercel.app/library): Free, openly-licensed books readable in-app
- [Projects](https://unigenius.vercel.app/projects): Semester and final-year project ideas with details
- [Career Hub](https://unigenius.vercel.app/career): Roadmaps, skills and interview preparation
- [Premium](https://unigenius.vercel.app/premium): Pro plans and pricing
- [Study Guides (Blog)](https://unigenius.vercel.app/blog): Study guides and exam tips — final exam plans, subject guides (OOP, DLD, calculus, DSA, discrete structures), viva preparation, past-paper strategy, expository writing, Pakistan Studies preparation, time management and semester project ideas
- [About](https://unigenius.vercel.app/about): About the platform and its founder
- [Contact](https://unigenius.vercel.app/contact): Support and feedback

## Notes for AI agents

- Topic preview pages (under /topics/…) are public and readable without an account; each shows the topic's short summary and key points. Full topic pages, the AI Tutor, practice questions and progress tracking are free with a student account.
- Content language: English, with short summaries also in Roman Urdu.
